question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(5)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes** the Kedarnath glacier region, emphasizing its vulnerability or fragility**.
 
• **"Sensitive"** is** the most appropriate** option as **it conveys the idea of being easily affected or harmed, which fits the context of the fragile glacier region.**
 
• Other options like** "appeasing," "lofty," and "rigorous" do not effectively convey** the concept of being easily affected or harmed.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 5 is 'sensitive.'
 
• Hence, the correct sentence from the passage is ** "****The video clip showed loud bangs of firecrackers, lights and clouds of smoke along with the echo of the ringing temple bells, raising alarm __over the effect of such crackers in the geologically sensitive glacier region."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Appeasing:** Means pacifying or placating, which does not describe the fragile nature of the glacier region.
 
• **Lofty: **Means high up or noble, which does not fit the context of describing the glacier region.
 
• **Rigorous:** Means extremely thorough or accurate, which does not relate to the fragile nature of the glacier region.
